summary: Robert Evans and Daniel Goodman read excerpts of Andrew Shaffer's 2018 bestseller Hope Never Dies, a mystery novel in which a jilted Joe Biden and Barack Obama investigate an Amtrak conductor's death tied to opioid smuggling in Wilmington, Delaware.

evidence.note: Host picks the first Obama-Biden mystery novel as a left-leaning counterpart to the Shapiro reading
Hosts criticise the book as nostalgic liberal fantasy amid the 2020 crises and Biden's campaign
Hosts review the author's career of quick parody and cash-in books
Novel set around Wilmington's train station and a local pool named for Biden
Plot resolves as a small fentanyl smuggling bust tied to the opioid epidemic
